resource: Live loop-dropped Ground items of one channel (ITEM-MOVE-2b drops)
allocation_impact: A drop locks its channel's row in game_item_loop_drop_channels, then counts the channel's live loop-drop Ground rows through a partial index, so the count always equals the live dropped rows (a pickup or a retirement lowers it in its own transaction). A drop that would make 20,001 is BLOCKED and writes nothing; the loop Ground read refuses a store holding more as invalid.
boundary_tests: max=20000: item_loop_drop_is_blocked_at_the_channel_cap_until_a_pickup_frees_room drops the 20,000th item and reads 20,000 loop Ground items
max+1=20001: the same case refuses the next drop as BLOCKED with an unchanged footprint, and commits it after a pickup frees one place
notes: ITEM-MOVE-WIRE-1 section 6 Limits; ITEM-LOOP-1 (CP D1438) #2190. The 80% alarm at 16,000 is not emitted yet: the durability writer has no metrics sink (follow-up). ITEMMOVE1-RL-01 (64 per tile) is enforced by the shared Ground cell limit.
